current_research_state.carrier: NP-complete connected/linear cubic positive Exact-One; exact forms include A=I+P+Q, affine parity intersect cycle-2factor independence, dual rank-3 perfect hypermatching, and Boben-reducible v3 Levi structure
established: Exact linear cubic Positive 1-in-3 SAT is NP-complete via a constant-size linear cubic EQ3 regularization gadget.
For cubic Exact-One, Boolean SAT is exactly affine parity Ax=1 mod 2 at Hamming weight n/3.

Affine-coset global Hamming optimality is equivalent to absence of a negative binary-matroid circuit; greedy descent uses at most n improving circuits, but universal polynomial negative-circuit synthesis on the full NP-complete carrier is not an admitted free primitive.

Any cubic bipartite Levi graph admits polynomial matching normalization A=I+P+Q; for a linear carrier the unmatched-pair graph is a simple cycle 2-factor, and Exact-One is exactly affine parity plus independence in that 2-factor.
A connected linear cubic rank-14 n=15 carrier is singular over Q but Exact-One UNSAT; singularity or lambda_min=-3 is not sufficient for SAT.

The EQ3 regularizer has local terminal-zero F2 gauge modes; recursively regularizing the connected linear-cubic UNSAT n=15 seed gives linear F2 nullity while preserving UNSAT. Raw F2 nullity is not a SAT/progress measure.
Factoring the obvious local EQ3 gauge modes exactly returns the original cubic source semantics; this quotient alone does not decrease NP-hard semantic complexity.
The local-swap family is SAT, connected, linear cubic, primitive for every m>=3, and has linear rational nullity; primitivity and raw nullity are not universal currencies.

Boben adjacent/A reductions terminate structurally in a polynomial bounded-width terminal class, but exact semantic transport is open; one-step needs at least 3 hidden states and an explicit legal two-step region forces rank/state at least 4.
A common holographic/matchgate basis for EQ3 and EXACT1 is ruled out on the current source language.
Three-port local matching realization of the all-or-none relation {000,111} is blocked by the delta-matroid/matchgate parity barrier.

Four-port one-toggle local matching gadgets do not become exact under additive Exact-Matching counters: alternating-path exchange converts OFF+ON to complementary mixed states while preserving the pairwise sum of every additive edge statistic (EMX-1).

The frozen connected linear-cubic UNSAT 15_3 control admits a clause-perfect relaxed occurrence assignment with variable degree profile (a0,a1,a2,a3)=(5,5,5,0), making it a hostile replay for local toggle+counter reductions.
The older Harries n_t=35*2^t high-nullity family is automatically Exact-One UNSAT because 3 does not divide n_t; retain it only as a structural stress family, not a SAT-side obstruction.

primary.goal: Find a genuine polynomial contraction for the NP-complete linear-cubic carrier by grouping source regions before translation to a tractable carrier; first test exact boundary relations of minimal grouped blocks for even-delta-matroid/matching realizability and a provable strict decrease of rank-3 excess.

secondary.goal: Construct a deterministic polynomial exact solver for affine parity plus cycle-2factor independence using source-specific polynomial syndrome/semantic compression; generic high-width affine+Krom shortcuts are forbidden.

reserve.goal: Use Boben A-reduction only if arbitrary reduction sequences admit an exact polynomial-size correlation algebra and polynomial witness reconstruction.

next_attack: Enumerate and symbolically derive exact boundary relations for the smallest connected grouped blocks of the linear-cubic Levi graph; test delta-matroid/matching realizability and identify any repeatable contraction that strictly lowers rank-3 excess while preserving witnesses.
If a grouped matching-realizable block exists, prove a polynomial coverage/decomposition theorem or construct a source-valid obstruction to coverage before invoking any Exact Matching donor.
For the affine-cycle form, derive a canonical source-specific compressed syndrome representation using b_i+b_p(i)+b_q(i)=0 and prove polynomial closure or explicitly falsify it.

Do not reopen local three-port matching gadgets, one-toggle additive-counter gadgets, EQ3 local gauge quotient, common EQ3/EXACT1 matchgate basis, raw-nullity, singularity, commutativity-only, or primitive/imprimitive routers.
Promote E8_D1 only after one route closes SOUND, COMPLETE, TERMINATES, POLY and polynomial witness reconstruction for every instance in the NP-complete linear cubic carrier.
